description: This file defines token kinds, token trie structures, and a lexer class for the Torch JIT frontend parser, including token recognition and handling logic.

classes.name: TokenTrie
classes.description: A trie structure for token recognition in the lexer.

classes.name: SharedParserData
classes.description: Shared data for parser initialization, including token trie.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Represents a lexical token with kind and source range.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Lexer class for tokenizing source input into tokens for parsing.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches tokens in the input stream based on current position and context.

methods.name: isUnary
methods.description: Determines if a token kind is unary.

methods.name: isBinary
methods.description: Determines if a token kind is binary.

methods.name: isRightAssociative
methods.description: Checks if a token kind is right-associative.

methods.name: validIdent
methods.description: Checks if a character position can be part of an identifier.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if a string segment is a number.

methods.name: isCharCount
methods.description: Checks if a character occurs a specific number of times in a string segment.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if a string segment is a string literal.

methods.name: isTypeComment
methods.description: Checks if a position in the source is a type comment.
